define the vector-specific entomological parameters

Source: R/model_params.R
def_vector_params.Rd

def_vector_params This function can be used to load entomological parameters for a mosquito taxon (species, complex or genus) from the package database (or another bionomics table), or to set the entomological parameters to new custom values provided by the user.

Taxa are identified by their name and level: the same name can denote a species and a complex. An. gambiae s.s. and An. coluzzii are merged in the data as "Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii"; the names "Anopheles gambiae", "Anopheles gambiae s.s." and "Anopheles coluzzii" are accepted for it with a warning. Complexes are stored under their label (e.g. "Gambiae"); "Anopheles gambiae complex" is also accepted with level = "complex".

Usage

def_vector_params(
  mosquito_species = "Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii",
  level = "species",
  hbi = "indoor",
  vector_table = NULL,
  bionomics_table = NULL,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

mosquito_species

string, name of the taxon. Default "Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii". Use list_all_species() to see the available taxa.

level

taxonomic level of mosquito_species: "species" (default), "complex" or "genus".

hbi

human blood index used as Chi: "indoor" (default, indoor HBI), "outdoor" (outdoor HBI) or "weighted" (HBI_indoor * endophagy + HBI_outdoor * (1 - endophagy); its standard deviation is approximated assuming independent estimates). For a custom vector_table, Chi is used as supplied unless hbi is "outdoor" or "weighted".

vector_table

data frame with custom vector entomological values. Must be provided if custom parameter values should be used instead of the ones in the package database. The data frame should use (a subset of) the column names of the database object vec_ent_param. Default value is NULL.

bionomics_table

optional bionomics table with the same structure as vec_ent_param (e.g. from read_bionomics_table()), used instead of the package database to look up mosquito_species.

verbose

boolean specifying whether any messages should be displayed during the execution of the function. Default value is TRUE.

Value

list object with the columns of vec_ent_param (with a custom vector_table: its columns only), plus hbi_source:

  • species_name, level, complex: taxon

  • imputed_traits: parameters without data for this taxon

  • M: parous rate (proportion of host seeking mosquitoes that have laid eggs at least once)

  • M.sd: standard deviation of the parous rate

  • Chi: human blood index (proportion of mosquito blood meals derived from humans), chosen with hbi

  • HBI_indoor, HBI_outdoor: indoor and outdoor human blood indices

  • A0: sac rate (proportion of mosquitoes who laid eggs in a day)

  • A0.sd: standard deviation of the sac rate

  • zeta.3: relative availability of different non-human hosts

  • td: proportion of a day that a mosquito actively seeks a host

  • tau: resting duration, time required for a mosquito that has encountered a host to return to host seeking

  • ts: duration of the extrinsic incubation period (time required for sporozoites to develop in mosquitoes)

  • endophily: proportion of indoor resting mosquitoes

  • endophily.sd: standard deviation of the endophily

  • endophagy: proportion of indoor feeding mosquitoes

  • endophagy.sd: standard deviation of the endophagy

  • hbi_source: which human blood index is used as Chi (absent for a custom vector_table with hbi = "indoor", whose Chi is used as supplied)

Standard deviations (.sd columns) are included where available.

Author

Monica Golumbeanu, monica.golumbeanu@swisstph.ch

Examples

# Retrieve the vector entomological parameters for An. gambiae s.s./coluzzii
gambiae_vec_p = def_vector_params()

# The whole Gambiae complex, using the outdoor human blood index
gambiae_complex = def_vector_params("Gambiae", level = "complex",
                                    hbi = "outdoor")
